lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Co6O8 (MgCo3O4) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies octahedral Co and Mg environments, with Co octahedra showing six geometric neighbors (four O and two Co) and Mg octahedra surrounded by six O neighbors. The Co and Mg octahedra share edges, and Co octahedra additionally share corners and edges with one another. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
